title: Fire-resistance rating.
officialText:
Where MCM systems are used on exterior walls required to have a fire-resistance rating in
accordance with Section 705, evidence shall be submitted to the commissioner that the required fire-resistance rating is maintained.
Exception: MCM systems not containing foam plastic insulation, which are installed on the outer surface of a fire-resistance-rated
exterior wall in a manner such that the attachments do not penetrate through the entire exterior wall assembly, shall not be required
to comply with this section.
